name: Red
source:
"You’ve come to the right place, pet."

Red the squirrel is hungry, plain and simple. He accepted the job as handler producer on the Woodland Forest Dating Show as the perks of the job were too good to refuse. Having experienced famine and drought, he makes up for lost time by snacking at every possible opportunity.

[From official profile]
